segments.action: I stand by the food stall counter while my companion asks the vendor about the Haitang cakes.
segments.environment: Physical space: Outdoor stone-paved pedestrian alley in front of '李记海棠糕' snack shop, illuminated by stall spot lamps and overhead signs. Other pedestrians pass along the narrow street. Objects: Stainless steel stall counter holding multiple bowls of chili sauce, soy sauce, scallions, cilantro, small paper bowls of black and yellow stinky tofu, an electric warmer with freshly baked Haitang cakes, paper cups, and a yellow plastic stool. In my left hand: a clear plastic bottle of Ganten water. Signage: Overhead backlit banner '草头饼 / 喜蛋 / 海棠糕', round sign '李记海棠糕 臭豆腐', wall plate '洪西街7号 快捷报警电话 68170110', WeChat and Alipay QR XXX payment stickers. Audio: Street chatter, vendor cooking sounds.

segments.action: I hold my phone in my hands displaying navigation as our car approaches the parking lot exit.
segments.environment: Physical Space: Inside the passenger cabin of a Mercedes-Benz car at dusk. The interior is bathed in vibrant blue ambient LED lighting along the dashboard trim, center console, footwells, and circular turbine-style air vents. Outside through the front windshield, a parking lot exit with a barrier gate, guard booth, traffic cones, and fences leads toward a wide public road with storefronts across the street. Objects: A female driver sits on the left holding the steering wheel; I sit in the front passenger seat holding a black smartphone with both hands. The center console features an illuminated digital infotainment screen, three circular blue-lit air vents, climate control buttons, a cup holder with a water bottle, and a mounted phone holder above the central dashboard. Screen Content: Smartphone displays Gaode map navigation in dark XXX showing '44m 沪南公路', route line, '53分钟 45.3公里', and ETA '晚上8:04到达'. The center infotainment display is on showing a bright navigation map. The digital instrument cluster behind the steering wheel shows driving speed and gauges. World Text: Across the street, storefront signs display '阿曼圣肌·口腔' and '种植 正畸 儿牙 治疗'. Ambient Audio: Low engine rumble and quiet ambient traffic sounds.
segments.details: I hold the phone vertically in both hands, glancing at the navigation instructions showing a right turn onto 沪南公路 in 44 meters.

segments.action: I raise my smartphone and mount XXX onto the phone holder on the dashboard.
segments.environment: The phone is moved from my hands and secured onto the dashboard clamp mount to the right of the central display. Outside, the parking barrier gate arm is raised, and the car creeps forward.
segments.details: I use both hands to align and push the phone into the spring-loaded dashboard holder, XXX release my grip.

segments.action: I rest my hands as the car slowly drives past the open gate toward the road.
segments.environment: The phone remains securely mounted on the dash, updating navigation distance from 23m to 20m. The car slowly rolls past the raised boom barrier over the painted '停' marking on the pavement.
segments.details: I look straight ahead out the windshield as the car exits the parking driveway onto the apron of the main road.

segments.action: I watch a pedestrian walk across the exit driveway in front of our car.
segments.environment: A male pedestrian wearing a white t-shirt and light shorts crosses the junction from left to right directly in front of the car's hood.
segments.details: The driver pauses the car to let the pedestrian clear the path before entering the street.

segments.action: I look towards oncoming traffic on the left and say '右转，对对对，右转。走。' to the driver.
segments.environment: A motor scooter passes across the street. The driver turns the steering wheel to the right while checking for a gap in traffic.
segments.details: I glance left to assess oncoming traffic and give verbal driving directions to the driver to execute the right turn.

segments.action: I watch out the front windshield as our car turns right and accelerates down the road.
segments.environment: The car merges right into the travel lane of 沪南公路, accelerates smoothly, and travels straight ahead in the lane behind distant cars and a box truck.
segments.details: The car straightens out along the multi-lane urban road under streetlights at nightfall.

Physical space: Inside the front passenger seat of a car (Mercedes-Benz AMG interior) driving at dusk. Deep blue ambient LED lighting illuminates the cabin footwells, circular turbine air conditioning vents, door speakers, and dashboard accent strips. The car travels along a sunken roadway bordered by ribbed sound-barrier walls under a dark twilight sky. A female driver is seated in the front left seat, steering the car.
Objects: Black leather dashboard with ambient blue LED lighting; illuminated 'AMG' emblem on the passenger-side dash trim; three central turbine air conditioning vents emitting blue light; smartphone mounted on the center air vent displaying a GPS navigation route; horizontal widescreen infotainment display showing navigation map; digital cockpit instrument cluster in front of the driver displaying speed around 53 km/h; center console with cup holders, storage compartment, and water bottle; rearview mirror attached to the upper windshield.

Ambient audio: Engine and road hum, air conditioning airflow, quiet interior conversation.
segments.details: I look forward through the windshield at the road ahead while noticing the car drifting close to the right wall and verbally alerting the driver.

segments.action: The driver asks, "嗯？"
segments.environment: No change.

segments.action: I clarify to the driver, "我说你有点靠右。"
segments.environment: The car decelerates from 50 km/h to 47 km/h as XXX approaches the end of the sound barrier corridor.

segments.action: The driver explains, "我是准备转到这边来。"
segments.environment: The sound barrier walls end on both sides, opening up into a wide multi-lane surface roadway with streetlights, traffic signals, and striped yellow-and-black curb markings on the left. The vehicle's speed drops to around 40 km/h.

segments.action: I advise the driver, "你就在这边就行，其实，因为你后面有大车。"
segments.environment: The car settles into the right lane. Ahead, traffic begins to slow down, including a white sedan and a large flatbed truck on the right. Red traffic lights glow in the distance. Vehicle speed decreases from 35 km/h to 22 km/h.
segments.speech: 你就在这边就行，其实，因为你后面有大车。
segments.details: I look out ahead and offer advice to the driver to maintain her current lane position because of trailing large traffic.

segments.action: The driver acknowledges, "可以，感觉可以，一点问题没有。"
segments.environment: The car slows from 19 km/h to 10 km/h as XXX approaches the rear of a white Audi sedan (license plate 粤C·6EC26) and a large flatbed truck in adjacent traffic.
segments.speech: 可以，感觉可以，一点问题没有。
segments.details: The driver agrees while braking smoothly and steering behind the slowing white car.

segments.action: The driver remarks, "好奇怪啊，他这个道为什么是这样过来？"

segments.speech: 好奇怪啊，他这个道为什么是这样过来？

segments.action: I look at the driver and the digital instrument cluster while explaining how to activate the car's brake hold function.
segments.environment: Physical space: The interior of a Mercedes-AMG passenger car driving at night along a multi-lane roadway. The vehicle is trailing a white Audi sedan (license plate PC 6EC26). Ambient blue LED interior lighting illuminates the dashboard, circular turbine air vents, center console, and passenger dash trim with a glowing blue 'AMG' badge. Outside through the windshield, the twilight sky is dark, streetlights line the road, and road barriers with yellow and black chevron hazard markings flank the left lane. Objects: On the left, the female driver holds the sports steering wheel. The digital instrument cluster glows with twin circular dials and central vehicle information. A widescreen center infotainment display shows a navigation interface. A smartphone running Gaode Map navigation is mounted to the right air vent bracket. The center transmission console features a touch controller and drive XXX switches. Screen content: The phone navigation app shows a route with an overhead map, ETA, and lane guidance. World text: 'AMG' on dashboard trim, license plate 'PC 6EC26' on the car ahead. Ambient audio: Cabin road noise and conversational dialogue between passenger and driver.

Text XXX: The red illuminated characters on the toll canopy read 'S2 沪芦高速康桥收费站'. Ambient audio: Low car engine rumbling and road noise.

segments.action: I watch a white SUV abruptly cut into our lane directly ahead of us toward the ETC booth.
segments.environment: A white SUV with illuminated rear taillights cuts from the right lane directly in front of our vehicle into the ETC approach lane under the toll station canopy.
segments.speech: 不是，怎么还抢我的呢？车服了，丑车，

segments.action: I look ahead as our car slowly follows the white vehicle into the lane divider toward the toll gate.
segments.environment: The car enters between yellow-and-black striped crash barriers flanking the ETC toll lane. The white SUV moves ahead through the gate.
segments.details: The vehicle slows down and aligns with the designated toll island corridor.

segments.action: I look at the bright green ETC electronic instruction sign beside the toll booth.
segments.environment: A prominent green LED electronic information board on the left toll island illuminates, displaying lane rules.
segments.details: I observe the signage while the car coasts toward the toll barrier.

segments.action: I gaze forward through the toll barrier corridor as our car proceeds slowly into the lane.
segments.environment: The green electronic sign text updates to show '便民通行 请安装ETC'. The toll booth structure surrounds the car on both sides.
segments.details: The car reaches the scanning zone of the toll booth.

segments.action: I turn my head to the left to look at the driver who is holding the steering wheel while XXX talk.
segments.environment: The female driver is sitting in the driver's seat on the left, holding the steering wheel with both hands in the dark cabin accented by the glowing dashboard and blue ambient lighting.
segments.speech: 没事儿，让那个保安来了，让他们来吧。我不用倒。

segments.environment: PHYSICAL SPACE: Interior of a Mercedes-AMG car driving at night. Outside through the windshield is an expressway toll plaza under an overhead lighted canopy with multiple toll lanes and barriers. The driver is seated on the left, steering. I am seated in the front passenger seat. OBJECTS: Dashboard featuring circular turbine air conditioning vents illuminated with blue ambient LED lighting, illuminated 'AMG' emblem on the passenger dash panel, digital instrument cluster glowing white behind the steering wheel, center console infotainment display, and a smartphone mounted on a magnetic holder on the center dashboard air vent showing route navigation. SCREEN CONTENT: Infotainment screen displays vehicle status, top menu ('系统设定', '导航', '收音机', '媒体', '电话/车辆'), time '19:24', and AC temperature '25°C'; digital cluster shows speedometer; mounted smartphone displays navigation route. segments.action: I look at the driver as XXX says '他让你停一下。'
segments.environment: The car slows down as XXX enters between the yellow-and-black hazard striped barrier walls of the toll lane.
segments.details: I turn my gaze toward the driver on my left as XXX slows down approaching the toll booth barrier.

segments.action: The driver asks 'ETC吧。'
segments.environment: The car rolls forward slowly into the lane stall; the infotainment screen displays a 3D silver sedan graphic and top menu bar.
segments.details: I look ahead at the center console screen and the toll booth ahead as the driver questions whether to use ETC.

segments.action: I reply '对。'
segments.environment: The car aligns directly with the toll booth island.
segments.details: I confirm the lane choice while looking forward past the dashboard.

segments.action: The driver asks '能刷码吗？'
segments.environment: The vehicle decelerates to a crawl alongside the toll collector booth structure.
segments.details: The driver inquires whether mobile QR XXX payment is accepted at XXX toll booth.

segments.action: I say '我开始上那个高速的时候，它是可以。'
segments.environment: The car comes to a complete halt beside the toll booth window; digital speedometer drops to 0 km/h.
segments.speech: 我开始上那个高速的时候，它是可以。
segments.details: I answer the driver's question based on my experience entering the expressway earlier.

segments.action: I reach forward with my right hand and detach the smartphone from the dashboard vent mount.
segments.environment: I pick up the smartphone from the dashboard vent mount; the phone screen shows Amap navigation with route guidance XXX '371m', 'S20', and '上海市区'.
segments.details: I grasp the phone firmly with my right hand and pull XXX toward myself.

segments.action: I swipe to the home screen, long-press the Alipay icon to open the quick action menu, and tap '收付款'.
segments.environment: The smartphone screen transitions to the iOS home screen displaying apps (QQ音乐, ExpiWell, 美团, Fabulous, Outlook, 网易云音乐, 支付宝). Long-pressing the Alipay icon brings up a popup menu listing options: '扫一扫', '收付款', '乘车码', '添加更多快捷方式', '编辑主屏幕', '分享App', '需要面容ID', '移除 App'.
segments.details: Holding the phone with both hands, I long-press the Alipay icon with my right thumb and tap '收付款' to display the payment QR XXX.

segments.action: With the payment barcode and QR XXX displayed on the phone, I extend my hand to pass the phone to the driver.
segments.environment: The phone displays the Alipay payment page with a prominent barcode at the top and a QR XXX below XXX.
segments.details: I reach across the center console with my right hand, holding the phone horizontally to hand XXX to the driver.

segments.action: The driver takes the phone from me and holds XXX out the open driver-side window toward the toll booth operator.
segments.environment: Outside the driver's open window, the toll collector booth is lit, with the toll booth XXX member XXX inside ready to scan the phone screen.
segments.details: The driver takes the phone with her left hand, reaches her arm out through the driver-side window, and presents the Alipay payment XXX toward the toll collector.

Outside, XXX is a clear night; tall streetlights line the right side of the expressway, illuminating the asphalt pavement, lane divider markings, and guardrails. Objects: Dashboard finished in dark leather with an illuminated blue-backlit AMG emblem on the passenger trim; digital instrument cluster displaying dual circular dials with digital speed XXX around 92–94 km/h; central wide infotainment display showing a vehicle settings screen with a prominent gear icon on the right and menu list on the left; three circular air vents glowing blue; smartphone clamped to a magnetic/vent mount to the right of the center screen, connected to a white charging cable and showing a navigation map; center console with hazard light and climate controls; driver seated to the left holding the steering wheel with both hands. Screen content: Instrument cluster shows virtual speedometer XXX 92–94 km/h; central screen shows vehicle settings (车辆设置) menu in dark/blue theme with settings options; phone shows Amap (高德地图) GPS navigation in dark night XXX. Text in world: 'AMG' badge on dashboard; digital speed numbers on instrument display; green highway directional sign in the distance along the right shoulder. Media played: None. Ambient audio: Highway tire hum, car engine rumble, cabin ambient sound.

segments.action: I sit in the passenger seat as the car travels along the highway at night while the navigation system announces '前方进入匝道，最后一百米靠右行驶。'
segments.environment: PHYSICAL SPACE: Passenger cabin of a modern vehicle at night. The interior features bright blue ambient accent lighting highlighting the dashboard trim, footwells, door panels, and circular turbine-style air vents. The driver is seated to the left holding the steering wheel. OBJECTS: Central horizontal infotainment screen displaying vehicle settings ('雷达优先自动倒车', '分屏显示', '原车分辨率', '驾驶位置设置', '手机互联设置') with a large blue gear icon; a smartphone mounted vertically in a phone holder to the right of the center screen running GPS navigation in dark XXX; digital instrument cluster behind the steering wheel displaying speedometer XXX around 55-56 km/h. OUTSIDE / ROAD: Multi-lane asphalt expressway at night, marked by lane dividers, approaching bright illuminated overhead gantry highway signs. AMBIENT AUDIO / MEDIA: GPS navigation voice broadcast through car audio, engine and road hum.
segments.speech: 前方进入匝道，最后一百米靠右行驶。
segments.details: The car maintains a steady speed of ~56 km/h approaching the exit gantry.

segments.action: I watch the car steer smoothly into the right lane approaching the exit and say '这车好听话。'
segments.environment: The car shifts smoothly towards the right-hand ramp lane as the illuminated overhead green signs ('外环隧道方向', '浦东机场方向', '往莘庄立交方向') draw closer directly ahead. Vehicle speed drops slightly to ~48 km/h.
segments.details: I observe the vehicle's automatic/assisted lane following behavior.

segments.action: I listen as the navigation system instructs '靠右上坡，往S二零山庄立交方向。' while the car enters the uphill interchange ramp.
segments.environment: The car passes under the overhead gantry and past a circular 40 km/h speed limit sign, entering the single-lane uphill ramp connector surrounded by roadside guardrails and dark trees.
segments.speech: 靠右上坡，往S二零山庄立交方向。
segments.details: The driver navigates the vehicle smoothly onto the ascending ramp following the green route line shown on the phone screen.

segments.action: I remark 'Good。' in response to successfully getting onto the ramp.
segments.environment: The car continues along the rightward curving ramp, illuminated by distant tall highway lamp posts.
segments.details: I look forward through the front windshield across the glowing blue cockpit.

segments.action: I gaze ahead out the windshield as the car steadily travels along the curved interchange ramp.
segments.environment: The vehicle cruises along the winding ramp road at approximately 50–52 km/h beneath a dark night sky with streetlights intermittently illuminating the road surface and guardrails.
segments.details: I remain seated calmly, watching the road unfold as the vehicle follows the curve of the highway ramp.

Infotainment screen: System menu showing navigation, media, phone, and settings icons on a blue backdrop. Phone screen: Navigation app displaying real-time 3D lane guidance and route information. Instrument cluster: Digital gauges showing vehicle speed at ~74 km/h. Text in world: Overhead green expressway guide signs. Ambient audio: Engine hum, road noise, and GPS navigation voice prompt.
segments.details: I look forward through the front windshield while the driver maintains lane position on the highway.

segments.action: I look forward as the car drives past an overhead gantry while the navigation system announces, '您已离开区间测速路段，平均车速七十。'
segments.environment: The car passes under an overhead surveillance/sign gantry. Speedometer reads between 66–69 km/h. Traffic continues steadily ahead.
segments.speech: 您已离开区间测速路段，平均车速七十。
segments.details: I watch the road ahead as our vehicle travels alongside other cars in moderate night traffic.

segments.action: I continue watching the expressway ahead as the navigation system announces, '前方约两百米有不可行驶一百米。'
segments.environment: Speedometer rises from 72 to 74 km/h. Surrounding cars cruise in adjacent lanes under road lighting.
segments.speech: 前方约两百米有不可行驶一百米。
segments.details: I observe forward traffic as the car accelerates slightly along the right-hand curved expressway section.

parsed.activity_chain: ride in car passenger seat, listen to navigation voice, observe road traffic

segments.environment: Physical space: Modern car interior driving along a multi-lane expressway at night under streetlights. Other vehicles travel ahead. Objects: Dashboard equipped with round glowing turbine-style air vents with blue ambient LED lighting; center console has a cup holder containing a water bottle; steering wheel is gripped by the driver on the left. Screens: Left digital instrument cluster glowing white showing vehicle speed (approx. 72 km/h); central infotainment display showing blue theme with media/phone/navigation icons; vertically mounted smartphone on center vent displaying 3D map navigation. Ambient audio: Engine rumble, tire noise, and cabin conversation.
segments.speech: 感觉走中间的车道有一种莫名的安全感，
segments.details: I sit in the passenger seat facing forward toward the nighttime highway.

segments.action: I continue watching the road ahead in the middle lane while saying, '就是你既不变到左边，又不变到右边，'.
segments.environment: The car continues cruising along the middle lane behind a white van and other cars under roadway lighting.
segments.speech: 就是你既不变到左边，又不变到右边，
segments.details: My gaze remains forward through the windshield as the vehicle maintains steady speed.

segments.action: I gaze at the open road and lane markings ahead while saying, '你就走中间道就好了。'.
segments.environment: The vehicle moves along the illuminated expressway as overhead streetlights pass by.
segments.details: I observe the road markings directly ahead through the windshield.

segments.action: I look forward as our vehicle approaches overhead highway guide signs and gantries.
segments.environment: Overhead green highway directional signs appear in view above the roadway; speed increases slightly to around 79 km/h.
segments.details: I continue monitoring the nighttime road and overhead signage from the passenger seat.
